questions.question: Four words have been given out of which three are alike in some manner, while one is different. Choose the odd one.
questions.solution:
Option 1 → Festoon is a chain or garland of flowers hung in a curve as a decoration.

Option 2 → Garnish is to decorate.

Option 3 → Adorn is to make more beautiful or attractive.

Option 4 → Demolish is to pull or knock something down.

All others represent something attractive or decorated, except demolish.

Hence, “demolish” is different.

questions.question: Find the unlike pair of words
questions.solution:
Option 1 → Tomcat is a male cat, while queen cat is female.

Option 2 → Chick is a young bird, while hen is a female bird.

Option 3 → Ant is a male, while queen ant is a female.

Option 4 → Stag is a male deer, while doe is a female deer.

All options represent species of both genders, except ‘chick and hen’.

Hence, “chick : hen” is unlike.

questions.question: In a distinct code language ATISH is written as AHIST and MAHEK is written as AEHKM. In that language, how will NARGIS be written?

ATISH → letters are arranged in alphabetical order. → AHIST

MAHEK → letters are arranged in alphabetical order. → AEHKM

questions.question:
Rahman went from his office to the district headquarters. He started his journey facing west. First, he went 20 km straight; then he turned to his left and went 9 km; finally, he turned right and went 20 km to reach the district headquarters.

What is the shortest distance between Rahman’s office and the district headquarters?
questions.solution:
Drawing diagram according to the given information,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/41a15cc836ad4949d95036a99d971b9d5bcee4a271bb0a739abb59da2e3d159c.png] 

Shortest distance between Rahman’s office and headquarters = √40² + 9² = √1600 + 81 = √1681 = 41 km.

Hence, “41 km” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
If ‘ + ’ is ‘×’, ‘ - ‘ is ‘ + ’, ‘×’ is ‘÷’, ‘÷’ is ‘ - ‘ then what will be the value of the following expression?

6 + (2)/(3) - (1)/(2) div (3)/(4) times 9
questions.solution:
According to given information:

 
 

 
 
 +

 
 
 
 -

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

 
 
Means

 
 
 

 
 
×

 
 
 
 +

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 
 -

 
 
 

Interchanging symbols and using BODMAS rule,

6 × 2/3 + 1/2 – 3/4 ÷ 9

= 6 × 2/3 + 1/2 – 3/36

= 4 + 1/2 - 1/12

= 9/2 – 1/12

= 53/12

Hence, “53/12” is the correct answer

questions.question:
In a class, five children wrote the aptitude test.

In the result report, it was noted that the child A got less marks than the child B. The child C got less marks than the child D. The child B is got less mark than the child C and child A got more marks than the child E. Which child got the second-highest marks?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

A got less marks than B

B > A

C got less marks than D

D > C

B got less marks than C

C > B > A

A got more marks than E

A > E

The correct order is,

D > C > B > A > E

C got the second highest marks.

Hence, “C” is the correct answer.
